In June 2025, we announced positive topline results from our Phase 2b CORAL trial, which was a dose-ranging study evaluating the efficacy, safety and tolerability of Haduvio for IPF-related chronic cough.
We expect to have topline results from the Phase 3 OCEAN-1 trial in the first half of 2028 and from the Phase 3 OCEAN-2 trial in the second half of 2027.
We expect to initiate this trial in the first quarter of 2027, subject to review of the trial protocol by the FDA, and we expect topline results from the Phase 2 trial in the first half of 2028.
In March 2025, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 2a proof-of-concept clinical trial of Haduvio for the treatment of patients with RCC, which we refer to as the Phase 2a RIVER trial.
We expect to report topline results from the full trial in the second half of 2027.
